---
title: "Configuration Reference"
description: "Every option of the fictional widget configuration file"
---

import { Option } from "/snippets/options.jsx";

The configuration file is a plain module that exports one object. Widget validates it at startup and stops with a clear message when a key is unknown.

## name

<Option type="string" required />

The project name. Widget prints it in status output and uses it as the default output folder name.

## retries

<Option type="number" default="3" />

How often a failing step is retried before the build stops. Retries wait a little longer each time, starting at half a second.

## timeoutMs

<Option type="number" default="5000" />

The time in milliseconds a single step may take. A step that runs longer is cancelled and counts as failed, which may trigger a retry.

## include

<Option type="string[]" default='["src"]' />

Folders whose files are inputs for the build. Paths are relative to the configuration file. Hidden files are ignored unless listed explicitly.

## exclude

<Option type="string[]" default="[]" />

Glob patterns removed from the input set after `include` has been applied. Use it for generated files that should never be inputs.

```ts title="widget.config.ts"
export default {
  name: "demo",
  include: ["src", "assets"],
  exclude: ["**/*.tmp"],
};
```
